title: TBD register: every open value with data source and owner
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Requirements, RAS and design docs contain many 'TBD' values. Each needs a named data source (test, research task, standard, engineer) before the MVP gate.
objective: Create a register listing every TBD in docs/ with location, what it controls, the task or test that will resolve it, and its MVP-gate criticality.
acceptanceCriteria: Every TBD in docs/ listed (state the search method)
Each row links to an existing task/test ID or proposes a new one
